articles.image_title: Louvre: epa11895965 Christophe Leribault, President of the Versailles Castle poses for a picture in one of the rooms of the apartment of the President of Congress after a press visit at the Versailles Castle in Versailles, France, 14 February 2025. Visitors will be able to visit the Congress Chamber and the apartment of the President of the Congress on weekends starting on 15 February to celebrate the 150th anniversary of the Third Republic of France. EPA/TERESA SUAREZ

articles.title: Paris: Direktorin des Louvre tritt nach Diebstahl zurück
articles.teaser: Diebstahl, Wasserschaden, Ticketbetrug: Wegen zahlreicher Missstände gibt die Chefin des berühmten Louvre ihren Posten ab. Emmanuel Macron nahm ihr Rücktrittsgesuch an.

REUTERS/Abdul Saboor
